div.div:
Topics and idempotent consumers
• payment.authorize → gateway charge (key = payment id) → recordPaymentNotification
• reservation.expire → cancel only if still PENDING_PAYMENT and past expiry
• refund.process → gateway refund (key = refund id) → mark refund once
• search.product_changed → re-read PostgreSQL → index with version_type external_gte
• order.changed → no-op (metrics/audit; NOTIFY already sent)
• sweeper → re-enqueues expiry for ACTIVE reservations past expires_at
